observer.description: Polls Spotify for playlist and library changes, diffs snapshot_ids, writes track_events to SQLite, emits alert payloads. Read-only against Spotify.

maintainer.description: Audits dependencies and detects Spotify API schema drift. Proposes patches as diffs. Never applies them without explicit approval.

growth.description: Analyzes audio features to profile playlist vibe and drafts marketing copy. Draft-only. Writes no outbound content and mutates nothing.
